title: Genetic map (HapMap II, GRCh37)
description: Genetic position in centimorgans at every chip locus, interpolated from the HapMap phase II recombination map. Converts a stretch of DNA into how much recombination separates its ends — what kinship analysis measures shared segments in.
licence: Public data, no restrictions (International HapMap Project)

source.name: HapMap phase II genetic map, GRCh37 (2011-01)

citation: The International HapMap Consortium. A second generation human haplotype map of over 3.1 million SNPs. Nature 2007;449:851–861
